verdict.rationale: Logseq's export docs say whole-graph or per-page export works in standard Markdown, JSON, EDN, OPML, HTML and Roam JSON. Community users confirm data lives locally as markdown files they keep in git. The community caveats concern native storage, not the documented export path: the new DB version no longer stores notes as markdown files, and one user calls the Markdown/Org backends non-standard. Missing for 10: a published schema for the JSON/EDN exports, plain-file native storage in the DB version, and hands-on confirmation that exports are complete and faithful.
